decisions.reason: The compact dumper builds on the established range, so it costs little to keep on the market while its uncertain prospects are still resolving after just one year.
The articulated dumper fits existing engineering, service and dealer capabilities, so the option stays cheap to hold and no evidence yet shows its value won't be realized.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and costlier to carry, but it draws on the firm's underground expertise in a niche with long sales cycles, so the uncertainty has not resolved enough to justify dropping it.
The multi-model telescopic loader line builds on the firm's lifting know-how and spreads its costs across several models, making it a low-cost option worth keeping while demand reveals itself.
